title: String Status Code Controlling Polymorphic Behavior
pattern: Using raw strings or integer code constants to control behavioral branching in business logic.
why_bad: Adding a new status or type code requires finding and manually updating every inline conditional block across the system, violating the Open-Closed Principle. Spelling mistakes compile silently, causing runtime failures.
detection: Frequent conditional `if-else` or `match` statements evaluating a raw string variable against a list of string literals.
counterexample: Simply logging a status code or returning it directly to an external API boundary.
fix:
Use an `enum` to enforce compile-time exhaustiveness, or use polymorphism (Strategy pattern) to delegate state-specific calculations.
```rust
enum ProductStatus {
    NewRelease,
    Regular,
}
```
